title: ftc file lawsuit alleging amazon deceived advertisers wsj reports 2026 08 31
text:
Aug 31 (Reuters) - The U.S. Federal Trade ​Commission on Monday sued Amazon.com (AMZN.O)
, opens new tab
, with ‌more than 20 U.S. states joining the lawsuit, according to court records.
The agency planned ​to file a lawsuit, alleging Amazon ​manipulated prices for advertisements on its ⁠e-retail platform, the Wall Street Journal ​reported earlier in the day, citing ​FTC officials.
The lawsuit would allege that the company deceived advertisers by secretly raising the minimum ​price they had to pay to ​place ads promoting their products, WSJ had reported.
Advertisers ‌allegedly ⁠suffered billions of dollars in harm from higher ad prices, while the states could seek civil penalties and attempt ​to recover ​some of ⁠that money, according to the report.
The e-commerce giant in September ​last year agreed to pay $2.5 ​billion ⁠in fines and reimbursements
, opens new tab
 to Prime subscribers to settle the FTC's allegations that it deceived ⁠its ​customers to generate subscriptions.
Amazon ​shares fell 3% in afternoon trading.
